GHL recorded 162 contacts and 10 opportunities created with 0 won, but these figures are unreconciled as no matching Windsor data is available.

performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark; organic GBP collapsing; 5 overdue SOW milestones block client renewal.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since Jul 23–Aug 31: phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and renewal scoreboard — none completed per record.
Zero paid spend across Meta and Google for all 28 days; CPL is undefined — no paid lead generation is running whatsoever.
GBP actions dropped 50% week-over-week to near-zero; last 3 days (Oct 13–15) show 0 GBP actions vs prior 3-day avg of ~3.3 — a confirmed 3-day collapse signal.
GHL shows 162 contacts and 10 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — intake pipeline has produced no attributable closed patients in 28 days.
GA4 sessions stable (~9–16/day recent 3 days) while sc_clicks rose 33% WoW; organic search is holding, but 0 GA4 conversions recorded — tracking or form issue likely.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib immediately; dashboard and attribution gap are renewal blockers.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW deliverables are overdue dating back to July 23, 2026 — phone-match attribution gap, sync/contact cleanup, the live dashboard, and two renewal-decision items. These are the client's stated scoreboard requirements; without them, the stay/walk decision cannot be made fairly. Assign owners in Monday immediately and set completion targets this week. Success check: all 5 items marked done or have a confirmed delivery date by 2026-10-20.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP collapse: 0 actions last 3 days vs 63 calls in 28-day window — check listing status and recent changes.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for the last 3 consecutive days (Oct 13–15) against a 28-day total of 148 actions and 63 calls — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise. Check the Google Business Profile for suspension, pending verification, category changes, or a Q&A/review flag that may have suppressed the listing. GBP calls are the only active lead source right now, so restoring visibility is urgent. Success check: daily GBP actions return above 5/day within 7 days; re-check 2026-10-20.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 conversions: 0 recorded despite ~264 sessions — confirm form/tracking fires before attributing lead volume to organic.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 264 sessions and 228 users over 28 days but zero conversions, while search clicks rose 33% week-over-week. This suggests a tracking gap — form submission events or goal completions may not be firing. Run a tag audit (GTM preview or GA4 DebugView) on the contact and appointment request forms. Success check: at least one conversion event confirmed firing in DebugView by 2026-10-20; re-check then.
